title: Apprentice Service Advisor at Porsche Centre South Dublin
description: Due to continued growth within the group, we are currently recruiting for an Apprentice Service Advisor to work in our modern Porsche Centre South Dublin showroom. Joe Duffy Group is Ireland’s leading motor retailer across 24 locations, 20 Franchises representing 13 brands, with a team of 600 employees and an enviable franchise portfolio of world-leading brands. This is a fantastic career opportunity to train as Service Advisor with Ireland's largest motor retail group. Successful candidates will complete a minimum of six months structured and comprehensive training. A full and clean Irish or EU driving licence (for both manual and automatic) is an absolutely essential requirement for this role. **Requirements** To be the focal and experienced point of contact for Porsche customers requiring servicing or repair to their vehicles. Managing the flow of information between the workshop, the rest of the Dealership and the customer, delivering excellent customer service at all times. To manage all service telephone and walk-in enquiries on behalf of the dealership. Qualify service needs and diagnose vehicle running problems where appropriate. Establish understanding and an agreement with the customer of the work to be carried out. Calculate workshop capacity insuring that all details are entered onto the service workshop loading system. Manage the handover and administration of Customer Service Vehicles. Explain the work carried out on vehicle ensuring customers full understanding and authorisation. Manage any necessary liaison with department manager regarding customer dissatisfaction. Follow up in line with dealership procedures. Understand and adhere to manufacturer brand service requirements. Maintain safe working practices and abide by the working rules and standards of the dealership. Maintain product knowledge on the full Porsche range. Maintain relevant systems ensuring accuracy at all times. This is a Trainee role and Joe Duffy Group have a comprehensive training programme in place which is tailored to suit individual's needs and can take six months to complete. During this programme, you will receive comprehensive training in the Joe Duffy Group process, database management, marketing, customer service and everything you will require to have a successful career in aftersales. During this training, the emphasis is on learning and developing your skills, being mentored, observing experienced service advisors, classroom and brand training. Ideally you will be able to demonstrate strong customer service, telesales, retail sales or customer contact experience. You do not need to have motor experience, but a desire to work in and an understanding of the motor trade. We will recognise and reward your hard work, achievements and loyalty with our excellent basic salary benefits package: Employment Assistance Programme Industry-leading training and progression plan Bike to Work Scheme 20 days of Annual Leave Life cover Active Social Club Pension If you are passionate about customer service, are driven and ambitious and believe that you have what it takes A full and clean Irish or EU driving licence and authorisation to work full time hours in the EU are essential requirements for this role Third Party Or Agency Assistance is Not Required - Thank You Joe Duffy Group is an equal opportunities employer

title: Assistant HR Executive

discretion at all times. * In-depth knowledge of computer packages, proficiency, and experience in the use of Word, Excel and PowerPoint are essential. * A full driving licence is an advantage. * title: Assistant Quantity Surveyor

title: Bookkeeper
description: **About the role** We’re working with a small, growing business backed by private investment. Our Dublin finance team has four accountants and supports operations across Ireland, the UK, the Isle of Man, Australia, and Japan. We’re looking for someone to join the team and take ownership of the day-to-day ledger work that keeps everything accurate. The role starts hands-on and, over time, grows into account preparation and reconciliation ownership, taking more work off the Accountant Manager. **What you’ll do** * Complete bank reconciliations across thousands of bank accounts in Xero, and investigate and clear differences at volume. * Prepare and post manual journal entries, with clear supporting documentation. * Review bank statements and transactions for accuracy and completeness. * Perform balance sheet reconciliations and keep supporting schedules up to date. * Support month-end and year-end processes by keeping the ledger clean and on time. * Identify errors, gaps and process improvements, and raise them early. * As you gain experience, take ownership of account preparation and reconciliation areas. **What we’re looking for** * Hands-on experience with Xero, ideally on a multi-entity or high-volume bank reconciliation process. This is a key requirement. * Experience in bookkeeping, accounts assistance or a similar finance support role. Accounting training or a qualification in progress (such as AAT, ACCA or similar) is welcome, and a degree in a related subject is a plus. * Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to reconciling and checking work at volume. * Confident Excel skills. * Some exposure to multi-currency transactions is helpful, given our international operations. * Good judgement and comfort working independently, taking responsibility for your own work and asking the right questions. * A willingness to learn, and a desire to build a long-term career in finance. **Profile** You’re someone who takes ownership, enjoys getting stuck in, and wants to build a solid foundation in finance. You may be early in your accountancy journey, or have technical skills and experience you’re ready to use more fully. You’re reliable, thorough and happy to work autonomously once you know the processes. **How we work** * Hybrid working, with one to two days a week in our Dublin office. * Flexible hours and a strong focus on work-life balance. * A small, supportive team of accountants where your work has a visible impact.

title: Boots Beauty Specialist
description: We’re shaking up the beauty scene at Boots, and our Beauty Specialists are leading the charge. This isn’t your average retail role – it’s a unique position at the heart of our beauty halls, where you’ll connect with customers and guide them to the best skincare, makeup and hair products for their needs. From cult favourites to the latest viral must haves, you’ll share honest, expert advice and help customers find what really works for them – all whilst driving sales through genuine, feel-good service. Whether it’s a glow up or a game changing product, they’re after, you’ll be part of making every customer feel their absolute best. **About The Role** * Reporting to the Assistant Manager, you’ll work across all premium/luxury beauty brands, offering expert, unbiased advice to customers giving them the best experience in store. * This is a sales-based role. You'll have targets to meet and we're about working as a team (not competing against each other for sales!) so you won’t be on performance-based commission. Instead, we provide up to £1000\* annual product allowance for you personally test, love and recommend our products. * This is a fun place to be, so you'll really get to use your sales and communication skills as you approach and interact with lots of customers with a variety of needs throughout the day. * We’re proud of our stores, so you will always keep the premium beauty hall and make up counters looking their best. You will take pride in ensuring all counters and testers are well stocked, cleaned and tidied throughout the day. * You'll have access to expert hands-on training with premium brands in store, plus a comprehensive learning programme through our online learning platform to keep building your beauty expertise. * You'll attend our famous virtual and in-person conferences where we bring our Beauty Specialists together for an immersive education experience. * As a Boots Beauty Specialist there may be opportunities to get involved with creating social media content, supporting with events or even the chance to be involved in some of our exciting campaigns. **What You'll Need To Have** * Enthusiasm & passion for make-up, skincare and haircare * A warm, approachable manner and the confidence to start conversations with customers. * A passion for achieving and exceeding sales targets or goals * Ability to work at pace. * Good communication skills, with the ability to understand customer needs. * A proactive approach to learning about new products, techniques, and services **It would be great if you also have** * Experience working towards sales or targets in beauty retail * A creative flair or interest in social content **Career development** Are you thinking about your future career goals? There are plenty of opportunities to continue your career with us; whether you progress within beauty to become a Senior Beauty Specialist or Beauty Assistant Manager, move into store leadership as a Store Manager, or even join our Support Office. **Our Benefits** * Quarterly product allowance totalling up to €1000 per year\* (\*subject to number of hours worked per week.) * Generous employee discounts * Ongoing training from our amazing brands and beauty experts * Pension Membership (PRSA) * Discretionary annual bonus * Partial paid maternity leave * Flexible benefits scheme * Access to free, 24/7 counselling and support through TELUS Health, our Employee Assistance Programme We have a great range of benefits in addition to the above that offer flexibility to suit you - find out more at **boots.jobs/ireland** . Exclusions may apply, eligible roles only. *Please note, any salary estimates given on third-party sites are not provided or endorsed by Boots and may not be accurate.* **Why Boots?** At Boots, we foster a working environment where consideration and inclusivity help everyone to be themselves and reach their full potential. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, passionate about embracing the diversity of our colleagues and providing a positive and inclusive working environment for all. As the heart of everything we do at Boots, with you, we change for the better. **What's next?** If this sounds like the perfect role for you, we look forward to receiving your application. If your application is successful, you'll be invited to complete an online assessment before attending an in-store assessment. Where a role is advertised as full-time, we are open to discussing part-time and job share options during the application process. If you require additional support as part of the application and interview process, we are happy to provide **reasonable adjustments** to help you to be at your best.

title: Business Development Representative

title: Credit Analyst - German Speaking
description: **About Wayflyer** Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer. Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan. You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney. **The challenge** Our German market is growing and deal volume is growing with it. We need an analyst who can decide which businesses we fund, turning incomplete information into a clear fund or no-fund call. Some of that information will come from reps and customers. **What You'll Actually Do** * Analyse financial and non-financial data on new and existing customers, and quantify the risks of running and funding an eCommerce business * Own the day-to-day relationship with our German-speaking sales and CS rep * Lead calls with German customers, acting as their trusted point of contact * Shadow customer calls at first, then lead them * Assess and structure loan opportunities across small, mid-market and enterprise deals, working with sales and operations * Present your fund or no-fund recommendation, with amount and payback terms, to managers and directors in our approval meetings, and work with the data and engineering teams on how their projects affect credit risk **What This Role Could Turn Into** This is a growing market and you’ll grow with it. You’ll start by owning relationships with our German-speaking reps and shadowing customer calls. From there, this role can lead to: * Senior Credit Analyst for the German market, handling escalations and leading customer calls and complex deals * Mentoring and coaching new Analysts as the German underwriting team grows, and shaping how we underwrite the market * Portfolio management or wider credit risk, with direct exposure to senior leaders through our approval meetings **Who Thrives Here** You’re curious, high-agency and entrepreneurial. Maybe you’ve run a side business, started a run club or led a university society. You think in first principles, can simplify complex problems, and balance risk with growth. You’re articulate, detail-oriented and a self-starter. You’ll probably end up doing things that aren’t in this job description. That’s not a warning - it’s the point. **We hire for range** * Fluent/Native German and English is required (note: these will be tested as part of the interview process) * 1-2 years in finance, auditing or a related field, or you’re a strong grad. A finance background isn’t essential * Comfortable with Excel, Word and PowerPoint. SQL or Python is a plus * Experience managing external customer relationships, or underwriting in the German market, is a bonus. CFA is welcome, not expected **Location and working policy** **📍** Berlin, Dublin or London. You’ll be in the office 4 days a week for your first 6 months, then it becomes flexible under our standard hybrid policy. **The good stuff** 25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and a pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want. *By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wayflyer Limited will process your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your suitability for the role. Such processing is based on the need to take steps prior to entering into a potential employment agreement. To learn more about how we handle your personal data, you can contact our privacy team at privacy@wayflyer.com or review our privacy notice at* *https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice* *.*

title: Customer Assistant

title: Customer Assistant -  Ringsend (30-35 hour)
description: **About the role** We pride ourselves on offering customers the biggest range of products around. And that's not just food, but everything from clothes and kettles to financial services. But did you know we offer the biggest job opportunities too? With stores across the UK and Ireland, and a variety of roles, we are always looking for people who are as passionate about helping customers as we are. Our Every Little Helps approach doesn't just apply to our customers. It's at the very heart of everything we do at work - and it's what makes us different. We believe in treating each other with respect, and everyone having the opportunity to get on. That's what makes Tesco such a great place to work. Should you be successful in your application, your offer will be subject to and conditional upon you providing your bank account details before your agreed start date. **You will be responsible for** * Always put the customer first and consider them in everything you do. * Get to know your customers and serve them with pride. * Help to ensure products and services are available for customers at all times. * Handle all products with care to maintain quality and ensure they reach the customer in the best condition. * Keep the shop floor and back areas clean and tidy at all times. * Using the training you receive, follow department routines and processes. * Follow all company policies and adhere to Health and Safety routines. * Whilst you will have a core role, you may be asked to support your colleagues by helping in other departments. **You will need** * Able to give great, natural customer service by proactively smiling, greeting, acknowledging and helping customers. * Works hard for customers, your team and your department. * You are able to prioritise to ensure anything you do is right for our customers. * Adaptable and resilient to meet the ever changing demands of our business. * You must be able to follow instructions either verbal or written. * You are reliable and a good timekeeper. * You must be smart and tidy at all times. **Whats in it for you?** We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren't limited to: * Competitive Salary * Bonus Scheme\* * Our Virtual GP service provides free and confidential access to an online GP through video GP consultations, and online prescription service for colleagues. The service is also available to families of colleagues who live at the same address for a reduced cost. * 24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life. * Colleague Clubcard offering 10% discount across stores and online, with 15% discount weekends once a month (Friday to Sunday), and 20% off twice a year. There is also 20% off F&F clothing, all year long, these various discounts can be extended to a family member with a 2nd Clubcard available.\* * Life Assurance * Pension Plan\* * Save As You Earn Scheme\* * Paid Family Leave * Bike to Work * Long Service Awards * Commuter Scheme * \*Entry requirements and rules of the scheme apply **About Us** Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer's favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move. Our core purpose is "Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day". Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers. It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children's Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity. Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food. We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards. We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated. At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings. We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best. We know life looks a little different for each of us. That's why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support. Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. We're committed to providing a fully inclusive recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require. For further information on the accessibility support we can offer, please click http://roi.tesco-careers.com/accessibility/ How can I let Tesco know I need additional support? Please let us know you need additional support by emailing tescoireland.recruitment@tesco.ie This will allow us to understand more about you and how we can best support you through the recruitment process.

title: Data Engineer II — Product Data Group
description: At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation. Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive. The **Data Engineer II** in the Product Data Group plays an active, hands-on role in implementing, optimizing, and maintaining data models and pipelines for product data (telemetry, logs, alerts, metrics, etc.). Working closely with senior engineers, data platform architects, and cross-functional product teams, this engineer helps transform raw system events into reliable, high-quality data assets. The role balances day-to-day pipeline engineering, automated testing, and observability with strong engineering fundamentals. **Primary Responsibilities** * Pipeline Implementation & Optimization: Build, optimize, and maintain scalable data pipelines and models for diverse analytics and product use cases, adhering to established data architecture, security, and access standards. * Data Lifecycle & Schema Management: Implement schema evolution, versioning, automated backfills, and resilient retry mechanisms across streaming and batch pipelines. * Quality & Observability: Implement automated data quality checks, pipeline observability, and alerting to monitor pipeline health against established SLAs; partner with senior engineers on root cause analysis (RCA) and remediation workflows. * Operational Excellence: Apply best practices in automated testing, monitoring, and runbook documentation to ensure continuous, reliable pipeline operations. * Data Cataloguing & Documentation: Contribute to comprehensive technical documentation, metadata repositories, and data lineage mapping in collaboration with data stewards and domain owners. * Cross-Functional Collaboration: Participate in engineering design reviews, code reviews, and sprint ceremonies; collaborate with software engineering teams to align on event schema design, source systems, and data contracts. **Desired Skills & Qualifications** *While all these skills are important, it isn’t critical that they all be met exactly. If you think you’re a fit for this role, please apply!* * Be kind. * Experience Level: 2–4 years of progressive hands-on experience in data engineering, preferably working with product telemetry, system logs, or event streams. * Data Modeling & SQL: Proven experience in database design, data modeling (relational, dimensional, or semi-structured), and SQL query performance optimization. * Pipeline Development: Solid experience designing and maintaining reliable batch and streaming data pipelines (ETL/ELT) using languages such as Python or SQL. * Testing & Quality Assurance: Hands-on experience implementing automated pipeline testing, data validation frameworks, and data quality checks. * Software Engineering Best Practices: Experience working with Git version control, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and modern agile software development processes. * Governance & Metadata: Familiarity with data cataloguing, metadata management, and operating within data governance frameworks. * Collaboration & Problem Solving: Strong communication skills, with an ability to clearly explain technical issues and collaborate across distributed engineering teams. Bonus Skills (Nice-to-Have) * Hands-on experience with modern data stack tooling: dbt, Databricks (including Unity Catalog), and AWS cloud data services. * Experience with distributed processing frameworks (e.g., Apache Spark) or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka). * Exposure to supporting data preparation and feature engineering for machine learning (ML) models. The Job Description is intended to be a general representation of the responsibilities and requirements of the job. However, the description may not be all-inclusive, and responsibilities and requirements are subject to change. **Please note that F5 only contacts candidates through F5 email address (ending with @f5.com) or auto email notification from Workday (ending with f5.com or** **@myworkday.com)** **.** **Equal Employment Opportunity** It is the policy of F5 to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and employment applicants without regard to unlawful considerations of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, sensory, physical, or mental disability, marital status, veteran or military status, genetic information, or any other classification protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, discipline, and termination. F5 offers a variety of reasonable accommodations for candidates. Requesting an accommodation is completely voluntary. F5 will assess the need for accommodations in the application process separately from those that may be needed to perform the job. Request by contacting accommodations@f5.com.

title: Data, Commercial & Technology Associate
description: **OVERVIEW** The Maples Group is a standard bearer in financial and legal services, trusted by many of the world’s largest hedge fund managers, private equity firms and international corporations. Our distinction flows from our carefully curated team: 2,500+ professionals characterised by tenacity, ethics and exacting excellence. Operating in key financial centres across the Americas, Asia, Europe and the Middle East, our international presence offers a unique springboard for career development and cross-cultural immersion. The Maples Group looks to add a Dublin based Data, Commercial and Technology Associate to our team and invites eager and qualified candidates to apply. We are committed to diversity, inclusion and equality of opportunity as we attract, retain and develop world-class talent. **Who We Seek** Our merit-based culture suits professionals in pursuit of boundless careers and lives. Beyond their acumen, team members are collaborative and conscientious, bringing a healthy sense of drive and purpose to each interaction and to all aspects of their work. **About the Role** This is a fantastic opportunity to take the next step in your career and join our successful and highly collegiate Data, Commercial and Technology (DCT) team. The DCT team advises international, institutional clients and Irish established innovation driven enterprises on a broad range of matters including data protection, AI, intellectual property, technology and commercial contracts. The group sits alongside our Corporate and Employment colleagues, collaborating regularly on high profile transactions with the other Dublin practice areas. This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with the lead partner and take an active role in growing the practice. This role requires the ability to provide technically accurate and complex advice to clients. The successful candidate will enjoy unrivalled exposure to quality and visible transactions and will be provided the opportunity to build their profile in the market. **EXPERIENCE** **What You Bring** The successful candidate will have strong technical skills, a strong work ethic and a commitment to providing legal support on a wide range of complex commercial transactions. The ideal candidate will have the ability to build relationships with clients and colleagues and work well in a team environment. The candidate's qualifications and experience will also include * Newly qualified (NQ) up to two years' post qualification experience * Highly relevant training and experience as a commercial lawyer with a particular focus and interest in GDPR compliance and investigations, emerging technologies, IP and data aspects of joint ventures and mergers & acquisitions. * Both experience and training should have been completed with a leading law firm in Ireland or the UK * Outstanding academics * Excellent drafting skills * The ability to work as part of a team and take an active part in sharing knowledge within the team This post requires significant attention to detail, professionalism, ability to multi-task, and excellent organisational, prioritisation and communications skills. **BENEFITS & REWARDS** The most enduring professional relationships are reciprocal relationships. The Maples Group prioritises employee health and wellbeing. Depending on your location, we offer a range of benefits, including: * Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental and optical) * Competitive vacation packages * Educational assistance and professional development programmes * Savings or pension plan * Life insurance * Travel insurance * Global mental wellness programme * Sports clubs and social events **ABOUT MAPLES GROUP** Over five decades, the Maples Group has grown from modest beginnings into one of the world's preeminent professional services firms, offering specialised fiduciary, fund administration, regulatory and compliance, entity formation and management and legal services on the laws of the British Virgin Islands, the Cayman Islands, Ireland, Jersey and Luxembourg. You can learn more about the Maples Group on our corporate website. Experience our culture and our people on our Careers Page or on LinkedIn. Any candidates invited to interview for a role in Maples and Calder, Dublin, will receive a sensory overview of the office, inclusive of sensory maps and accessibility information. Please note that it is the Maples Group standard policy to undertake various background screening checks on all applicants to whom a conditional job offer is made. Except for roles based in the Republic of Ireland, the background checks will include criminal records checks when a conditional job offer is made. If you have a criminal record, it does not mean that your job offer will be automatically withdrawn. The Maples Group will make all job offer decisions on a case-by-case basis and will take a number of factors into account, such as the role that you are applying for and the nature and circumstances of the past offence. You will have the opportunity to discuss the matter with us before a decision is made. Further details will be provided at the time any conditional job offer is made. Disclaimer: All personal information collected during the application process will be used for recruitment-related purposes only. Please refer to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice at maples.com/privacy for details on how we handle personal information relating to job applicants.

title: EUV International System Install Engineer
description: **Introduction** to the job Do you want to be responsible for ensuring a smooth installation process of our advanced lithography machines at our clients, all over the world? Become an International Upgrade, Install and Relocation Engineer at ASML to build and test some of the most amazing, complex machines that you’ll ever see! This means a lot of travelling (70-80%) for long periods (4 - 6 weeks) of time, continuous learning, and being surrounded by many diverse cultures and environments. Do you take on this life-changing opportunity? As this role is the perfect start to your long-lasting ASML career, many other departments crave your expertise once you have gained experience in this role. Additionally, you get the opportunity to learn from deeply knowledgeable colleagues whilst encountering new challenges every day. EUV represents a big leap forward in semiconductor manufacturing, enabling our customers to create even more powerful and more efficient chips. This team will be based in Ireland as part of the EU EUV UIR department and will focus on flying out to customer sites around the world and supporting in the EU region. The team will primarily perform reinstalls but also other UIR (upgrade, install and relocation) activities as per business needs. **Role and responsibilities** To be able to transfer a fully tested and qualified lithography machine at our client’s site, you will be cross trained in multiple activities within a unique cleanroom environment. Besides that, as an International UIR System Reinstall Engineer you will: * Work in accordance with the installation sequence and installation procedures; * Work in day-night shift schedule (12-hour rotations) at customer sites around the world; * Perform tests (calibrations and system qualification) to ensure equipment qualification; * Troubleshoot and solve system failures and demonstrate self-reliance in challenging situations; * Take ownership, lead a shift to deliver quality; * Manage technical escalations; * Contribute to the improvement loop of our lithography machines and processes; * Represent ASML at the customer site in a professional way; * When not working abroad, the engineer is expected to assist local customers. **Education and experience** To help us tackle the technical challenges we face, you need: * Bachelor or Master’s degree in a technical discipline (preferably mechanical, aerospace, electronic, mechatronics engineering); * Knowledge of mechanics, pneumatics, hydraulics, vacuum systems; * Practical hands-on experience gained through previous work, projects, labs, internships, or student teams (e.g. assembly, prototyping, troubleshooting); * A valid driver’s license; * Legally authorized to access controlled technology as defined in Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. * 730 et seq.). **Skills** Working at the cutting edge of tech, you always have new challenges and problems to solve. Being creative and working together is the only way to do that. To further thrive as an International UIR Engineer, you will need the following skills: * Safety‑first mindset; * Flexibility. Spending 70 – 80% of your time travelling around the world and working in flexible shift patterns at customer sites, sometimes at short notice; * Adaptable and resilient under pressure, with flexibility to work in different schedules and environments; * Clear and effective communication skills, with focus on reporting, knowledge sharing, influencing, and supporting; * Quality‑driven (“first time right”); * Passion for hands‑on engineering challenges; * Being open-minded, team player and be able to use your own initiative (self-sufficient); * Awareness of cultural differences and ability to collaborate in diverse international environments. **Other Information** We only consider candidates who have uploaded an updated version of their CV and a cover letter stating their motivation to apply for this specific role at ASML. (Please take some time to really think about your cover letter, as this is the perfect opportunity to present yourself for our Hiring Managers). Please be advised, for this role we require candidate with a valid international driver’s license. Travel is estimated to be around 75%. This percentage is an estimate and can be revisited in mutual agreement. The home location will be Leixlip, Ireland. Main locations for travel are supporting worldwide, Israel and the in the European Union. (Re)installations/other UIR activities will be supported on all EUV customer sites worldwide. Candidate should be able to travel to the EU with no barriers (next day travel) and should have the ability to get proper visa to other locations when required. The job content is in transition and it is required that the employee is comfortable with a dynamic and changing environment. It is expected that you are open-minded, show initiative and join us to thrive in our new identity. This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the United States Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. * 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology. *This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the* *United States* Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. * 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. title: QC Technician
description: Quality in manufacturing is not just about completing checks. It is about knowing when something is right, recognising when it is not, and taking action. We are looking for a QC Technician to join our Quality team at WaterWipes in Drogheda. This is a hands-on role working closely with Production and Engineering to make sure our products, materials and processes meet the standards we expect. This is an onsite role working a 3-cycle shift pattern. The Opportunity As QC Technician, you will be part of the day-to-day operation of our manufacturing site, completing quality checks, analytical testing and product inspections that directly influence whether product and materials can be used or released. The role covers water batching and testing, microbiological sampling, equipment calibration, in-process quality checks, GMP compliance and the management of non-conforming or quarantined product. You will need to be comfortable making decisions based on what the data and inspections tell you, escalating issues quickly and working with colleagues across Production, Engineering and Quality to resolve problems. What You’ll Be Accountable For **You Will** * Batch and test water to support production requirements, including analytical and chemical testing and microbiological sampling using aseptic techniques. * Complete start-up, calibration, metal detector and routine QC checks, making clear decisions based on results. * Carry out in-process checks to confirm products are meeting specification and take appropriate action when they are not. * Identify, isolate and document non-conformances, supporting root cause analysis and CAPA follow-up with internal teams and suppliers. * Quarantine defective or potentially defective finished product and raw materials, maintaining accurate records and full traceability. * Monitor GMP standards and complete routine GMP, Glass and Perspex audits. * Maintain accurate, timely quality records and follow SOPs, SSOWs and site procedures. * Communicate quality issues clearly to Production and Engineering and help train production colleagues on required quality checks. * Support external audits, accreditations, NPD trials and pilot production runs. * Maintain high standards of safety, compliance and organisation within your work areas. Who This Role Is For This role will suit someone who enjoys being close to the manufacturing process and takes pride in getting the detail right. Previous experience in a quality environment or FMCG manufacturing would be valuable. The existing role profile highlights around two years of quality experience and/or internal quality training as desirable rather than essential, so we are also interested in people who have developed relevant quality experience internally and are ready to step up. **You Should Have** * A good working knowledge of GMP and the importance of following defined procedures. * Experience working with SOPs in a manufacturing or quality-controlled environment. * Confidence using Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint. * Previous FMCG quality experience would be an advantage. What Will Make You Successful Here You will do well in this role if you are practical, observant and prepared to take ownership. You notice when something does not look right and investigate rather than overlook it. You can learn technical processes and apply them consistently, while also using good judgement when a decision needs to be made. You will also need strong attention to detail, clear written and verbal communication, good prioritisation and time management, and the ability to work effectively as part of a wider team. Above all, we are looking for someone who understands that good quality decisions matter and is comfortable taking responsibility for them. Why Join WaterWipes At WaterWipes, Quality is part of how we operate, not something we check at the end. As a QC Technician, you will have a role where your decisions have a visible impact on what happens on the production floor. You will work across Quality, Production and Engineering, gain exposure to different parts of the manufacturing operation and contribute to trials, improvement activity and audit readiness. It is a role for someone who wants to build practical quality experience while being trusted to take ownership of the standards they are responsible for. Location & Practicalities **Location:** WaterWipes, Drogheda, Co. Louth **Working arrangement:** Onsite **Shift pattern:** **3-cycle shift-based role** Because this role supports live manufacturing operations, flexibility and reliable attendance across the 3-cycle shift pattern are important. Call to Action If you have quality or manufacturing experience, strong attention to detail and the confidence to make decisions when something does not meet the required standard, we would like to hear from you. Apply to join WaterWipes as our next QC Technician. WaterWipes® was created by our founder Edward McCloskey after his newborn daughter developed a nappy rash on her sensitive skin. After an extensive search he couldn’t find a baby wipe that didn’t contain numerous ingredients, so he decided to make his own. Many years later and after a lot of hard work, testing, and scientific research, WaterWipes® was born. Pure and gentle for the most delicate skin but in the convenience of a baby wipe, WaterWipes® are purer than cotton wool and water. Every day, parents around the world are discovering the benefits of our gentle and effective WaterWipes® for their baby’s skin. We hope you like them too.

title: Systems Analyst, SaaS Operations Onboarding
description: **Role summary : The Onboarding Analyst implements and transitions Charles River IMS environments for new SaaS clients. The role combines technical delivery, client coordination, production readiness, issue resolution and operational handover across DEV, UAT and PROD environments.** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Purpose and scope** --------------------- Working within the CRD SaaS Onboarding team, the analyst owns assigned onboarding activities from environment setup through go-live and transition to operations. The role works closely with Professional Services, clients, Infrastructure, NetOps, Database, SaaS Operations, Engineering and third-party vendors. It requires hands-on technical capability, clear stakeholder communication, disciplined governance and sound judgement when escalating delivery or production risks. **Key responsibilities:** * Plan and execute onboarding activities for new clients and new environments, maintaining clear ownership, dependencies, risks and target dates. * Coordinate environment readiness across DEV, UAT and PROD, including infrastructure, application configuration, access, monitoring, capacity and production-readiness checks. * Work with client and internal network teams to establish and validate connectivity, firewall rules, peering, endpoints, certificates and third-party integrations. * Set up and validate interfaces and messaging components such as FIX, IBM MQ, Kafka, file transfer and vendor connectivity, including Bloomberg, Omgeo and Cassini where applicable. * Install and configure Charles River IMS components; deploy patches, hotfixes, plug-ins and add-ons through approved CI/CD and Azure DevOps pipelines. * Design, build and validate complex BOD/EOD batch schedules and operational jobs; support Tidal or equivalent enterprise job-scheduling technologies. * Perform troubleshooting across applications, Windows/Linux services, databases, APIs, authentication, networks and integration flows; coordinate resolution with the correct resolver teams. * Prepare and execute Disaster Recovery tests, document outcomes and close identified gaps before production acceptance. * Support UAT, implementation weekends and go-live activities, including occasional out-of-hours coverage and disciplined handover to support teams. * Maintain accurate documentation, knowledge articles, runbooks, configuration records, open-issue lists and decision logs; identify and implement process improvements. * Manage client and service-partner communications, monitor satisfaction, and escalate material risks or blockers to senior management using sound judgement. **Required competencies and experience** * 1-5 years of experience supporting or implementing mission-critical production software, preferably within financial services, investment management or a SaaS environment. **Open to recent graduates and early- career professionals.** * Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL, including data investigation, basic performance diagnosis and safe execution of operational queries. * Experience with scripting or automation using PowerShell, Python, Windows Batch or a comparable language. * Practical understanding of Microsoft Azure or AWS infrastructure, networking, security, compute, storage, monitoring and high-availability concepts. * Experience with enterprise job scheduling, software installation, configuration management, release deployment and incident/problem resolution. * Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical issues into clear actions, risks and decisions for clients and internal stakeholders. * Ability to manage multiple workstreams, follow controlled processes and produce reliable documentation in a high-growth, time-sensitive environment. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. **Preferred knowledge** * Applications and domain: Charles River IMS; trade order management; middle-office, back-office or other financial applications; investment-management workflows. * Platforms and operations: Windows/Linux servers; Azure DevOps; CI/CD; monitoring; databases; clusters/high availability; DR/BCP; production support. * Integration and connectivity: FIX; APIs; gRPC; IBM MQ; Kafka; SFTP/file transfer; LDAP/SSO; certificates; vendor and client network connectivity. * Delivery behaviours: Client focus; ownership; structured troubleshooting; accurate status reporting; risk escalation; collaboration; continuous improvement. **Success measures** * Environments and integrations are delivered to agreed scope and readiness dates with no avoidable production defects. * Risks, dependencies and issues are visible, owned and escalated early, with accurate stakeholder reporting. * Batch, interface, DR, monitoring and operational handover evidence is complete before go-live approval. * Knowledge articles and runbooks are reusable, current and sufficient for SaaS Operations/GOC support. * Clients and internal partners experience clear ownership, timely communication and effective resolution during onboarding. **Working arrangements** This is a client-facing role that may require participation in implementation windows, go-lives, Disaster Recovery exercises and critical issue resolution outside normal business hours. The analyst is expected to comply with CRD change, access, security, documentation and production-governance controls. Employees are expected to work from the office **4** days a week. **About State Street** **What we do.** State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients. **Work, Live and Grow.** We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary in locations, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Program to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential. **Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.** We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspective are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome the candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift program and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you. State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers **About State Street** ====================== Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future. title: Vision Systems & Quality Validation Technician
description: **Vision Systems & Quality Validation Technician** **UNITED CAPS | Build your career in manufacturing technology** **Are you a recent Engineering or Manufacturing graduate looking for an opportunity to put your knowledge into practice? Interested in automation, technology and problem-solving?** UNITED CAPS is looking for an enthusiastic and motivated **Vision Systems & Quality Validation Technician** to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone at the beginning of their career who wants to develop specialist technical skills within a modern manufacturing environment. You will play an important role in supporting and improving our automated inspection technology, helping us maintain the highest standards of product quality and packaging compliance. You don't need to be an expert in machine vision systems already. We are interested in your potential, technical curiosity and willingness to learn. With hands-on experience, training and support from experienced colleagues, you will have the opportunity to develop into a specialist in this growing area of manufacturing technology. **What will you be doing?** Working closely with our Production, Engineering and Quality teams, you will help manage, validate and continuously improve our machine vision inspection systems. Your responsibilities will include: · Developing, maintaining and optimising machine vision inspection programmes for different products. · Configuring inspection settings to ensure accurate and reliable defect detection. · Maintaining approved programmes, backups and system documentation. · Carrying out validation studies and routine checks to ensure inspection systems perform as expected. · Developing and maintaining libraries of defect samples. · Investigating inspection failures, quality issues and customer complaints. · Analysing inspection data and identifying opportunities to improve performance. · Helping reduce unnecessary product rejects while ensuring genuine defects are detected. · Supporting operators and production colleagues through training and technical guidance. · Participating in continuous improvement projects and quality initiatives. **What are we looking for?** We would love to hear from candidates who have recently graduated or have some early experience in an engineering, manufacturing or technical environment. Ideally, you will have: · A degree, HNC, HND or equivalent technical qualification in Engineering, Manufacturing, Automation, Mechatronics, Electronics or a related discipline. · An interest in automation, manufacturing technology and quality systems. · Good analytical and problem-solving skills. · Strong attention to detail and a logical, methodical approach. · Good communication skills and the ability to work with different teams. · A positive attitude, enthusiasm to learn and the confidence to take ownership of tasks. Experience with machine vision systems such as Cognex, Keyence, IMD Vista or similar would be an advantage, as would knowledge of Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma. However, **previous machine vision quality system experience is not essential**, as training and development will be provided. **Who would suit this role?** This role would be ideal for a recent graduate who is keen to start their career, put their technical knowledge into practice and develop within a manufacturing business. It would also suit someone with some experience in production, engineering or quality who is looking to take their next career step into automation and machine vision technology. We are looking for someone who is curious, proactive and enjoys solving problems. Someone who isn't afraid to ask questions, share ideas and learn from others. **If you're enthusiastic about technology, enjoy problem-solving and want to develop a specialist career with UNITED CAPS, we'd love to hear from you!** **The Company** UNITED CAPS is a global industry reference for the design and production of high-performance plastic caps and closures. As a dedicated partner, we enable customers to evolve and extend their own packaging solutions and to maintain their leading position. Therefore, we make custom designed specialty closures for a wide variety of international companies in the packaging markets. The company is headquartered in Luxembourg and has manufacturing facilities in Belgium, France, Germany, Hungary, Ireland, Luxembourg, Malaysia and Spain. Salary: 40,000.00 euros Shift: Monday to Friday 8am-4:30pm with some flexibility due to business demands Pay: €40,000.00 per year Benefits: * Private medical insurance * Sick pay Work Location: In person

description: Job Req Number: 132664 Time Type: Full Time At DSV we're building the world’s leading logistics and transport network. With this exciting growth comes opportunity — and we’re looking for new talent to join us. **Warehouse Operator** **Location: Quantum** **Hours: Monday to Friday, 14:30 to 23:00** At DSV, your work helps keep the world moving. We're looking for a Warehouse Operator to join our team and support the safe, accurate, and efficient handling of customer products within our warehouse operation. **What will you be doing?** * Receive, unload, and store customer goods * Complete stock movements and transactions using a Warehouse Management System (WMS) * Perform stock checks and maintain inventory accuracy * Pick, pack, and prepare customer orders for dispatch# * Support kitting, repacking, labelling, and other warehouse activities * Operate material handling equipment where certified * Maintain high standards of safety, quality, and housekeeping * Follow warehouse procedures and report any hazards or discrepancies **About You** * Previous warehouse or logistics experience preferred * Good attention to detail and accuracy * Strong communication and teamwork skills * Basic computer literacy * Experience using WMS systems is desirable * Reach Truck licence is desirable but not essential * Reliable, safety-conscious, and customer-focused approach **What can we offer you?** Competitive Salary Package and an opportunity to be a part of and grow within a driven and successful company, with a team of 160,000, operating in over 90 countries. In addition, we can offer access to a selection of employee benefits, such as: Enhanced Annual Leave Entitlement from your start, which increases with length of service. Salary Sacrifice Cycle Scheme Employee counselling, for support with physical and mental wellbeing Company Pension, which, when a member of, also provides access to Life Cover and Critical Illness cover **Next Steps** If this sounds like the next step for you, please follow the links and apply with your CV without delay! Please be aware that all successful candidates will undergo necessary right-to-work checks and certain sites require 5-years’ worth of referencing and background checks. *We do not accept CV details from Recruitment Agencies unless DSV have engaged directly regarding the role requirements beforehand.* **DSV – Global transport and logistics** **What moves you?** At DSV, we move more than goods. We move careers, ambitions and opportunities. With close to 150,000 colleagues in over 90 countries, we are the global leader in transport and logistics, and it is our people who bring our services and solutions to life every day. From frontline operations to business functions, every role contributes to keeping supply chains flowing and societies running. Here, you are trusted to take ownership, act on your ideas and make decisions that create real impact. It is a place where people, careers and ideas keep moving forward. We value transparency in how we communicate and collaborate, and we win together by supporting each other, challenging each other and delivering results as a team. **Start here. Go anywhere** This is our promise of movement. A promise that your work matters, your contribution counts, and your career can move as far as your ambition takes it. If you are looking to make an impact, grow your career and be part of something bigger, DSV is the place to be. Visit dsv.com and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook #StartHereGoAnywhere
